method: Read-only comparison of saved Noa audit metadata, Genie execution records and original/copy-preserved log filesystem timestamps. No new load test, process/VM/model start or stop, stream action, Noa configuration change, credential access or other-chat message.
status: BLOCKED for causal attribution; temporal overlap observed

noaWarningInterval.meaning: Noa application guard marks critical after 30 seconds of warning; OS pressure remains 2, not OS critical4. memory_pressure_stop records a requested protective close, not independently observed live broadcast termination.

correlatedGenieWork.timeJST: SIGTERM log ends 04:04:01.545; menu Quit log ends 04:05:09.373
correlatedGenieWork.finding: Both complete logs contain normal service stop. The normal-Quit completion log precedes the first warning by about 41 seconds. Saved 04:07:27 manifest confirms app PID gone, supervisor exit0 and empty owned Docker project; it says no active translation child/transaction.
correlatedGenieWork.classification: Product app/service startup and idle shutdown verification; not a sustained production use benchmark
correlatedGenieWork.limit: Log timestamps lack event-by-event wall clocks; no synchronized per-PID footprint. Filesystem times support ordering but are not independent process traces.

correlatedGenieWork.work: Foundation scroll policy build/test and native background fixture round1
correlatedGenieWork.finding: Overlap with onset of warning. Saved native log shows controlled fixture input and a stale_frame failure. Policy script uses swiftc; native harness creates/compiles owned fixtures.
correlatedGenieWork.limit: File creation/final-write bounds are metadata proxies, not exact sampled compiler allocation. Native round1 begins just after the first warning; sequence does not prove it initiated pressure.

correlatedGenieWork.finding: Occurs during the recorded warning state before the next normal event.
correlatedGenieWork.limit: No peak allocation measurement; cannot quantify contribution.

correlatedGenieWork.finding: Recorded during the tail of the warning interval; completed before normal transition04:08:45.
correlatedGenieWork.limit: Not proof of initial warning cause; exact co-residency/footprint unknown.

correlatedGenieWork.work: Native round3 and disabled-button Swift tests
correlatedGenieWork.finding: These selected runs are after the normal transition, so do not explain warning onset.
The idle owned VM remained present after the app/services shutdown, consistent with a background resource contribution during the warning. Its later stop occurred after pressure normalized.
correlatedGenieWork.limit: A prior2CPU/2GiB profile setting is a configured ceiling, not measured resident memory. No warning-time VM RSS/GPU capture was found in the reviewed records; do not assign a2GiB causal delta.

conclusion.developmentLoad: Genie development verification and retained dedicated VM temporally overlapped the Noa warning and may have contributed to shared memory pressure. This is a possibility supported by overlap, not a proven allocation cause.
conclusion.productRuntime: The evidence does not establish Genies normal app/runtime as the warning cause. The controlled idle app/services had completed shutdown before warning onset; the workload visible during warning was development verification and idle infrastructure.
conclusion.otherFactors: Noa model/voice/OBS and other app allocations were not captured synchronously at the peak. A prior03:20 warning with Genie stopped and the older hidden7B-test residency are separate observations; neither identifies the04:05 peak owner.
conclusion.neededForCausality: A quality-preserving, owner-coordinated synchronized timeline of pressure, physical/GPU allocation by process, model warmup and actual OBS output over an authorized workload. This review did not run it.

conflictingOrCoarseObservations: The04:07:27 shutdown manifest reports postCheckMemoryPressure1 without exact probe timestamp/key. Noa transition log next reports normal at04:08:45. These differently sampled/coarse observations cannot be treated as a single continuous pressure trace.
noSecretProjection: Only source/log hashes, numeric metrics, event/time metadata and fixture result categories are retained. No conversation or stream content.
